scope: One independent 2.5 us PSCAD long-window diagnostic for the same ideal grid waveform as the qualified coarse precision trial.

numerical_factor.source: Reuse the coarse trial construction and formula with the actual 2.5 us DELT. Native MainDyn computes the three signed instantaneous kV signals at j*DELT and updates the original three ideal source_1 branches before solving.
numerical_factor.invariants: Keep the original fine physical network, DC-negative numerical reference, sparse threshold 1, actual differential voltage and current measurements, nominal physical source, controller and setpoints, all 45 native outputs, exact 5 us gate scheduling, and the 2.5 us midpoint holds.

execution.source: Independent native build and run, generated-code admission and original native INF/five OUT/CSV in a new local ignored directory, same PSCAD/GFortran as the coarse study.
execution.bind: Bind this file's trial_sha256 in addition to original protocol_sha256.

acceptance.same_grid: Against the sealed original fine PyCy result, keep all original physical, timing, switching, current, PLL-state, lock, tracking and power limits on the original clocks and all nine windows.
acceptance.native_grids: Compare the new independent coarse and fine native trials on their original time grids using the unchanged 15 cycle-mean windows and eight PWL RMS windows, with respective 0.10 A and 0.20 A limits.
acceptance.formal: Qualification of the two new references is followed by a fresh public dual-grid PyCy comparison and the normal example acceptance. Preserve the original native references and initial failed comparison as evidence.
